SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO

GO

ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CoreCustomerAccountPayroll_DEP] AS
BEGIN
--GET DELTA FROM BUSC

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountPayroll
AS(
SELECT DISTINCT
BDGEN.FORACID AS [CustomerAccountId]
,BDG.BANK_ID AS [FinancialInstitutionId]
,BDG.LCHG_TIME AS [Timestamp]
,BDG.FREE_CODE_3 AS [EmployeePayrollAccountIndicator]
,BDG.FREE_CODE_4 AS [EmployerPayrollAccountIndicator]
,'DEP' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,BDG.INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM BUSC.DEP_GAC BDG  
LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDGEN ON BDGEN.ACID = BDG.ACID   AND BDGEN.ISLATEST = '1'
WHERE BDGEN.FORACID IS NOT NULL AND BDG.ISLATEST = '1' 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountPayroll FROM TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountPayroll;


--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA

WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountPayroll_SRC
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
[CustomerAccountId]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,CONVERT(DATETIME,[Timestamp])
,[EmployeePayrollAccountIndicator]
,[EmployerPayrollAccountIndicator]
)) 
HASHROW, CustomerAccountId,FinancialInstitutionId
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountPayroll 
),

TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountPayroll_TGT
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
[CustomerAccountId]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[Timestamp]
,[EmployeePayrollAccountIndicator]
,[EmployerPayrollAccountIndicator]
)) 
HASHROW, CustomerAccountId,FinancialInstitutionId
FROM BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountPayroll
WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' 
)
,

TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountPayroll_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT
SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId, TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId, TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
,CASE
    WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
    WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
    ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

FROM TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountPayroll_SRC SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountPayroll_TGT TGT
ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountPayroll_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountPayroll_DELTA;


UPDATE TGT
SET
[CustomerAccountId] = SRC.CustomerAccountId
,[FinancialInstitutionId] = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,[Timestamp] = SRC.[Timestamp]
,[EmployeePayrollAccountIndicator] = SRC.EmployeePayrollAccountIndicator
,[EmployerPayrollAccountIndicator] = SRC.EmployerPayrollAccountIndicator
FROM BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountPayroll TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountPayroll_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountPayroll SRC ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId;

--INSERT TO BNKM

INSERT INTO BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountPayroll
(
[CustomerAccountId]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[Timestamp]
,[EmployeePayrollAccountIndicator]
,[EmployerPayrollAccountIndicator]
,[SOURCESYSTEMCODE]
,[WORKFLOWID]
,[TASKRUNID]
,[INSERTDTTM]    
)


SELECT
SRC.[CustomerAccountId]
,SRC.[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[Timestamp]
,[EmployeePayrollAccountIndicator]
,[EmployerPayrollAccountIndicator]
,'DEP' AS [SOURCESYSTEMCODE]
,0 AS [WORKFLOWID]
,0 AS [TASKRUNID]
,[INSERTDTTM] 
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountPayroll SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountPayroll_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId
WHERE  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountPayroll;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccountPayroll_DELTA;

END
GO
